tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description:
List tasks from the user's board in priority order (rank 1 is the most
    important task in its column). Each task includes tracked hours, money earned,
    urgency (rate multiplier), client, project and creation date. Filter by status,
    client or project.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description:
Get one task in full: the complete description and every tracked time
    entry (start, end, minutes).

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: List the user's clients with their hourly rate and number of open tasks.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects: code (the prefix of task numbers, e.g. "TT"), name and client.

tools.name: time_report
tools.description:
Report how much time was tracked and how much money was earned over a
    period, grouped by client, project, task or day. Covers all tasks, including
    unfinished ones. Money is calculated at the client's hourly rate at the time of
    work, multiplied by the task's urgency.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description:
Create a task in the "To do" column of the user's board, optionally for a
    client or project. Requires a token with write access.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description:
Change a task: pass only the fields that change. A task moves to
    "In progress" only when the user starts its timer, so that status is not
    available here. Paid tasks cannot be changed; for tasks from an agency only the
    status can change. Requires a token with write access.

tools.name: prioritize_tasks
tools.description:
Set priorities: the listed tasks move to the top of their columns in exactly
    this order (the first is the most important). Other tasks in the column stay
    below in their previous order. Requires a token with write access.
